activities.title: Take panoramic photo overlooking the Singapore Strait
Spot the Marina Barrage and Helix Bridge from above
Enjoy refreshment at the rooftop deck café

stops.full: Perched 200 meters atop three hotel towers, the SkyPark offers breathtaking 360-degree vistas of the city skyline, bustling shipping channels, and Gardens by the Bay.
stops.name: Marina Bay Sands SkyPark
precautions: High wind conditions on open observation deck; hold onto hats and light accessories.
Weather closure: Deck access may pause briefly during sudden electrical thunderstorms.
stops.short: Panoramic 57-storey observation deck overlooking the Singapore Strait.
tips: Book timed-entry slot online to bypass the ground ticket queue.
Morning visits typically offer the clearest skies before midday haze.
Keep your camera strap secured when approaching glass barriers.

activities.title: Walk the aerial catwalk around the indoor waterfall
Experience the Flower Dome Mediterranean garden
Watch the evening Garden Rhapsody Supertree light show

stops.full: Home to the 35-meter-tall Cloud Mountain veiled in mist, exotic orchids, pitcher plants, and the soaring Supertrees connected by the OCBC Skyway.
stops.name: Gardens by the Bay & Cloud Forest
precautions: Do not touch or disturb sensitive cloud forest orchid exhibits.
Walking surfaces can be slightly damp near the mist dispensers.
stops.short: World's largest climate-controlled glass greenhouses with indoor mountain waterfalls.
tips: Bring a light cardigan or wrap — the conservatories are cooled to a crisp 23°C.
Stay until 7:45 PM for the free Garden Rhapsody music and light choreography.

activities.title: Order mixed chicken and beef satay skewers from Stall 7 & 8
Sip fresh sugarcane juice with kalamansi lime
Sample Hainanese chicken rice from the heritage aisle

stops.full: Built in 1894, Lau Pa Sat seamlessly marries colonial architectural elegance with Singapore's vibrant UNESCO-recognized street food culture.
stops.name: Lau Pa Sat Hawker Market
precautions: Inform stalls in advance if you have peanut or shellfish allergies (satay sauce contains peanuts).
Brisk crowds during peak dinner hours; stay aware of personal bags.
stops.short: Victorian cast-iron landmark with the famous evening open-air Satay Street.
tips: Satay Street (Boon Tat Street) closes to vehicles from 7:00 PM nightly.
Look out for 'Choping' — tissue packs placed on tables mean they are reserved.
Carry cash or local mobile pay for traditional beverage stalls.

activities.title: Spin the giant prayer wheel on the rooftop terrace
Browse traditional herbal medicine apothecaries
Taste warm egg tarts from Tong Heng bakery

stops.full: Immerse in the Buddhist cultural museum, ornate golden prayer wheels, and stroll the preserved shophouse arcades of Pagoda and Smith Streets.
stops.name: Buddha Tooth Relic Temple & Chinatown
precautions: Remove hats and silence mobile phones before entering main shrine hall.
Respect worshippers during ongoing morning chanting ceremonies.
stops.short: Tang Dynasty-styled temple housing sacred relic, surrounded by historic shophouses.
tips: Complimentary sarongs are provided at the entrance if knees or shoulders are exposed.
Visit the quiet rooftop Orchid Garden and prayer wheel pavilion for tranquility.

activities.title: Photograph Sultan Mosque framed by palm-lined Muscat Street
Explore indie fashion boutiques on Haji Lane
Sample authentic Nasi Padang or Murtabak

stops.full: Discover colorful street murals along Haji Lane, fragrant artisanal perfume houses on Arab Street, and the grand golden dome of Sultan Mosque.
stops.name: Kampong Glam & Haji Lane
precautions: Sultan Mosque interior is closed to tourists during Friday prayer sessions.
Narrow alleys can become crowded; be courteous when taking street photos.
stops.short: Historic Malay-Arab enclave with golden Sultan Mosque and vibrant indie boutiques.
tips: Best photography lighting along Haji Lane murals is early afternoon.
Try traditional Teh Tarik (pulled milk tea) at Bhai Sarbat.

activities.title: Walk across the glass link-bridges between heritage courtrooms
Admire Georgette Chen and Raden Saleh masterpieces

stops.full: Spanning two national monuments connected by bridges of filigree metal and glass, presenting the largest public collection of modern art in Southeast Asia.
stops.name: National Gallery Singapore
precautions: No flash photography in specialized historical galleries.
Large backpacks must be checked at the complimentary coatroom.
stops.short: Former City Hall and Supreme Court transformed into premier visual arts museum.
tips: Download the gallery's companion audio tour app for free curated guides.
Visit the rooftop garden terrace for views of the Padang and Marina Bay.

activities.title: Spot the historic Anderson and Cavenagh suspension bridges
Capture sunset illumination of the Merlion fountain

stops.full: Take in the historic bridges, Fullerton Hotel, the Merlion statue, and the dazzling evening reflections of Marina Bay Sands from the water.
stops.name: Clarke Quay River Bumboat Cruise
precautions: Keep life-vest instructions in mind and remain seated while boat is in transit.
stops.short: Electric wooden bumboats gliding along the tranquil Singapore River at twilight.
tips: Depart roughly 20 minutes before sunset for the golden-hour skyline transition.
Boats depart every 15 minutes from the Clarke Quay Jetty.

activities.title: Watch the majestic manta ray feeding session
Walk through the 360-degree acrylic shark underwater tunnel

stops.full: One of the world's largest marine facilities, housing more than 100,000 marine animals across 40 diverse oceanic habitats.
stops.name: S.E.A. Aquarium Sentosa
precautions: Flash photography is strictly prohibited to protect aquatic vision.
Strollers and walkers: elevator access is available at every zone.
stops.short: Colossal aquarium featuring hammerhead sharks, manta rays, and coral habitats.
tips: Take the Sentosa Express monorail from VivoCity directly to Resorts World.
The Open Ocean Habitat viewing panel offers serene seated relaxation.

activities.title: Cross the timber suspension bridge to the islet
Relax under coconut palms with fresh coconut water

stops.full: White sand beach lined with tropical palms, calm swimming lagoons, and two timber viewing towers facing the open Singapore Strait.
stops.name: Palawan Beach & Suspension Bridge
precautions: Apply sunscreen (SPF 50) and stay well-hydrated under tropical humidity.
Observe lifeguard beach warning flags if entering the swimming lagoon.
stops.short: Cross the swaying wooden bridge to the Southernmost Point of Continental Asia.
tips: Complimentary Sentosa beach shuttle runs every 10 minutes.
Climb the timber towers for a refreshing coastal breeze and cargo ship views.

activities.title: Admire VIP celebrity orchids named after global figures
Relax by Symphony Lake and the Shaw Foundation stage

stops.full: Stroll along shaded palm valleys, the serene Swan Lake, and marvel at the National Orchid Garden's vibrant collection of over 1,000 species and 2,000 hybrids.
stops.name: Singapore Botanic Gardens & Orchid Garden
precautions: Stick to paved trails and avoid feeding local monitor lizards or waterfowl.
Mosquito repellent is recommended for wooded garden sections.
stops.short: 165-year-old tropical botanical garden and Singapore's first UNESCO World Heritage Site.
tips: Entry to the main Botanic Gardens is free; Orchid Garden has a nominal admission.
Early morning is ideal to beat the midday tropical heat.

activities.title: Photograph the 40m Rain Vortex from the forest trail
Pick up souvenir Kaya coconut jam and Pandan chiffon cake
Walk the Canopy Bridge with glass bottom panels

stops.full: Directly connected to airport terminals, Jewel seamlessly integrates nature and commerce under a toroidal glass-and-steel dome with Canopy Park mazes.
stops.name: Jewel Changi & HSBC Rain Vortex
precautions: Keep carry-on bags zipped and trolley wheels locked near escalators.
stops.short: World's tallest indoor waterfall cascading 40 meters through a lush terraced forest.
tips: Early baggage check-in is available right in Jewel for major international flights.
The best viewing deck is on Level 2 near the Shake Shack terrace.

document_guides.description: Singapore requires international visitors to hold a passport valid for at least six (6) months beyond the planned date of departure.
document_guides.title: Passport Validity Requirement

document_guides.description: All travellers must submit the electronic SG Arrival Card (SGAC) within three (3) days prior to arriving in Singapore. The service is free of charge on the official ICA portal.
document_guides.source: Official ICA SG Arrival Card Portal
document_guides.title: SG Arrival Card with Electronic Health Declaration

document_guides.description: Many nationalities enjoy visa-free entry for tourism up to 30 or 90 days. Always confirm specific visa requirements directly on the official ICA website. Roamly provides travel preparation tools but does not issue or guarantee visas.
document_guides.title: Visa & Entry Guidance

packing.title: Travel insurance policy card & emergency hotline
Primary wallet & contactless travel credit cards
Singapore Dollar cash (small notes for hawkers)
House keys & luggage TSA lock keys
Light breathable linen / cotton shirts (5 days)
Light cardigan / wrap (for chilly AC & Cloud Forest)
Smartphones with local eSIM / roaming active
Personal prescription medications & basic first aid

announcements: Welcome to Singapore! Meet at Pan Pacific Lobby at 09:30 AM tomorrow for morning briefing.
Remember to wear lightweight modest attire covering shoulders & knees for the Chinatown temple stop.
trip.meeting_point: Changi Airport T3 Arrival Hall / Pan Pacific Lobby
trip.summary: A serene 5-day journey blending futuristic architecture, lush garden canopies, vibrant cultural enclaves, and world-renowned hawker cuisine.
trip.title: Singapore Explorer
